title: God Has Not Forgotten You
description:
If you've done everything right and still feel overlooked, this is for you. Joseph knew that feeling, and his story didn't end in the pit.

Key Scriptures: Genesis 40:23, Isaiah 49:15.

Lord, when I feel forgotten, remind me that you never forget me. Amen.

scenes.narration: You did everything right... and still, nobody remembered you.
scenes.visual_prompt: A lone figure sits on the edge of a bed in a dark room, rain streaking the window, slow push in

scenes.narration: Maybe you're asking the question you're afraid to say out loud. Has God forgotten me?
scenes.visual_prompt: An empty road disappearing into fog at dawn, camera drifting forward

scenes.narration: Joseph knew that feeling. Betrayed by his brothers. Sold as a slave. Left in a prison cell... for two more years.
scenes.visual_prompt: Dim stone cell, a single shaft of light falling across a young man's hands

scenes.narration: But hear what God says to you tonight. Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you.
scenes.text: Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!
scenes.author: Isaiah 49:15
scenes.visual_prompt: Light breaking through heavy storm clouds, slow tilt up

scenes.narration: The prison was not the end of Joseph's story. And this is not the end of yours.
scenes.text: This is not the end of your story
scenes.visual_prompt: Sunrise spilling over a mountain ridge, golden light across the valley

scenes.narration: So lift your head. Take the next step. You are not forgotten.
scenes.visual_prompt: A figure walking up a hill toward the rising sun, wide, steady
